children: Farmhouse appointed Kevin Asher as Chief Financial Officer, principal financial officer and principal accounting officer effective October 12, 2026, as Lanny R. Lang resigned those officer roles and transitioned to Senior Director of Financial Reporting.
Chief Financial Officer; principal financial officer; principal accounting officer
Former Chief Financial Officer and Chief Accounting Officer; now Senior Director of Financial Reporting (non-officer)
Resigned (from officer positions) and appointed to non-officer role
Voluntary resignation; not due to disagreement with the Company on any matter related to operations, policies, practices, financial statements or disclosures
Replaced by Kevin Asher as CFO

Former Farmhouse CFO until Jan 1, 2021; consulting through Ashstrom, LLC since 2022; COO & CFO of BDI Logistics since May 2013; prior CFO roles at 3Win Corp. and Calibrus; BS in Accountancy from Northern Arizona University.

Will lead financial reporting, coordinate external accounting providers, prepare financial statements and footnotes, coordinate SEC filings, corporate governance support, and shareholder/transfer agent correspondence.

title: Farmhouse appoints Kevin Asher as CFO as Lanny R. Lang resigns CFO role
